mapper.sql: l.labeler_id, l.plant_cd, l.labeler_cd, l.labeler_nm, l.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, t.last_seen_at as terminal_seen_at, l.conn_mode, l.tpl_id, p.tpl_cd, l.deadline_ms, l.use_yn, l.remark, l.row_ver, l.updated_at
from wms_labeler l join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id join wms_label_tpl p on p.tpl_id = l.tpl_id
mapper.select: select where l.labeler_id = #{id}
select where l.terminal_id = #{terminalId} and l.use_yn = 'Y' and t.revoked_at is null

insert into wms_labeler (comp_cd, plant_cd, labeler_cd, labeler_nm, terminal_id, conn_mode, tpl_id, deadline_ms, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.labelerCd}, #{f.labelerNm}, #{f.terminalId}, #{f.connMode}, #{f.tplId}, #{f.deadlineMs}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning labeler_id
mapper.sql: b.box_id, b.plant_cd, b.box_cd, b.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, b.qty, b.lot_no, b.ref_no, b.label_skip_yn, b.sscc, b.status, b.attempt_cnt, b.last_reason_cd, b.prefetched_by, b.prefetched_at, b.done_at, b.row_ver, b.created_at, b.updated_at
mapper.select:
select order by
b.box_cd b.status b.created_at
desc,
b.box_id desc limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}
select count(*)
select from wms_labeler_box b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.box_id = #{id}

select from wms_labeler_box b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and b.box_cd = #{boxCd} order by case when b.status in ('VERIFIED', 'SKIPPED') then 1 else 0 end, b.box_id desc limit 1 for update of b
select from wms_labeler_box b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.box_id = #{id} for update of b
select item_id from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

insert into wms_labeler_box (comp_cd, plant_cd, box_cd, item_id, qty, lot_no, ref_no, label_skip_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{f.boxCd}, #{itemId}, #{f.qty}, #{f.lotNo}, #{f.refNo}, #{f.labelSkipYn}, #{by}, #{by}) returning box_id
mapper.update: update wms_labeler_box set qty = #{f.qty}, lot_no = #{f.lotNo}, ref_no = #{f.refNo}, label_skip_yn = #{f.labelSkipYn}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where box_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and status = 'REGISTERED'

update wms_labeler_box set status = #{status}, sscc = #{sscc}, last_reason_cd = #{reasonCd}, attempt_cnt = attempt_cnt + #{attemptAdd}, prefetched_by = #{prefetchedBy}, prefetched_at = case when #{prefetchedBy}::bigint is null then null else coalesce(prefetched_at, now()) end, done_at = case when #{done} then now() else done_at end, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where box_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from wms_labeler_box b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and b.status = 'REGISTERED' and b.label_skip_yn = 'N' order by b.box_id limit #{max} for update of b skip locked

select from wms_labeler_box b join mst_item i on i.item_id = b.item_id where b.status = 'PREFETCHED' and b.prefetched_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{hours}) order by b.box_id limit 500 for update of b skip locked
mapper.insert: insert into wms_labeler_event (comp_cd, labeler_id, box_id, request_id, event_cd, action_cd, reason_cd, sscc, scanned, elapsed_ms, answer, detail, src, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{labelerId}, #{boxId}, #{requestId}, #{eventCd}, #{actionCd}, #{reasonCd}, #{sscc}, #{scanned}, #{elapsedMs}, #{answer}::jsonb, #{detail}, #{src}, #{occurredAt}, #{method}, #{by})
mapper.select: select answer::text from wms_labeler_event where labeler_id = #{labelerId} and request_id = #{requestId} and event_cd = 'REQUEST'
select coalesce(box_id, 0) from wms_labeler_event where labeler_id = #{labelerId} and request_id = #{requestId} and event_cd = 'REQUEST'
select exists (select 1 from wms_labeler_event where labeler_id = #{labelerId} and request_id = #{requestId} and event_cd = #{eventCd})
select request_id from wms_labeler_event where box_id = #{boxId} and event_cd = 'REQUEST' order by event_id desc limit 1

select e.event_id, e.labeler_id, l.labeler_cd, e.box_id, e.request_id, e.event_cd, e.action_cd, e.reason_cd, e.sscc, e.scanned, e.elapsed_ms, e.detail, e.src, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_by from wms_labeler_event e left join wms_labeler l on l.labeler_id = e.labeler_id where e.box_id = #{boxId} order by e.event_id limit 500

insert into wms_labeler_dev_log (comp_cd, labeler_id, event_cd, code, detail, reply_cd, occurred_at, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{labelerId}, #{eventCd}, #{code}, #{detail}, #{replyCd}, #{occurredAt}, #{by}) returning log_id
select plant_cd as "plantCd", plant_nm as "plantNm" from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by plant_cd
select exists (select 1 from sys_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y')
